title: narcissus aureus var. cupularis
intro: Narcissus aureus var. cupularis, commonly known as the Wild Trumpet Narcissus, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including the treatment of respiratory problems, inflammation, and digestive disorders. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus aureus var. cupularis are attributed to its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help in relieving symptoms of coughs, colds, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
